layouts.name: Belle Isle
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The series 2016 event course description and official track map identifies the full Belle Isle street course, including the Northeastern outer extension and Southern fountain return. The pinned 2022 named raceway retains this complete loop, excluding pit access and the older inner Northeastern closure. The independently mapped 3765.4 m length remains unscaled against the 3813 m catalogue scalar; historical barrier and fine corner alignment remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3765.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
